# KivoReach

> AI-based digital marketing company that helps businesses get found, trusted and chosen, on Google and in AI search. Get found. Get trusted. Get chosen.

Free SEO tools that read real data (they say when data is not available), free guides, and SEO and AI search (GEO/AEO) services. Previously called AMK Digital Agency.

## Free SEO tools

- [Domain Overview](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/domain-overview.html): Domain age, WHOIS details, SEO health and security for any website in one free report.
- [Website Comparison](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/website-comparison.html): Competitor website analysis: compare two sites side by side for SEO health, domain age and security.
- [SEO Audit, Page Analyser, AI readiness, Domain Age and Domain Rank](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/free-tools.html): Five quick checks on one page.
- [Title Generator](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/title-generator.html): Write page titles of the right length. Runs in your browser.
- [Meta Tag Analyser](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/meta-tags.html): Title, description, canonical, robots and social tags, with a search result preview.
- [Heading Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/headings.html): The full H1 to H6 outline of a page and any structure problems.
- [Image and Alt Text Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/images.html): Which images have no text description or no size set.
- [Link Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/links.html): Internal and external links on a page, with a broken-link test.
- [Redirect and Status Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/redirects.html): Every redirect hop and status code from the typed address to the final page.
- [Robots.txt and Sitemap Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/robots-sitemap.html): The crawl rules a site gives search engines, and its XML sitemaps.
- [SSL Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/ssl-check.html): Whether the security certificate is valid, who issued it and when it ends.
- [Schema and Open Graph Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/schema-social.html): Structured data types on a page, errors in them, and social preview tags.
- [Keyword Density and Readability Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/keyword-density.html): Most used words and phrases on a page, word count and reading ease.
- [Website Technology Checker](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/tools/technology.html): Systems a site is recognisably built with, its server and security headers.

## Guides (KivoReach Academy)

- [Google Search Guidelines Index](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/compliance-index/): An index of Google Search Central guidelines mapped to practical checks, so you can audit a website against each requirement.
- [Crawling and Indexing Basics](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/crawling-indexing-basics/): How Google finds and indexes pages: crawling, URL canonicalisation, fixing crawl errors and pausing a site safely.
- [How to Use the Free SEO Tools](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/how-to-use-the-free-tools/): Step-by-step help for each free SEO tool: what to enter, how to read the result and what to fix first.
- [JavaScript SEO and Rendering](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/js-seo-mobile-rendering/): How Google renders JavaScript: rendering basics, single-page apps and routing, web components and app shell sites.
- [Redirects and Site Migrations](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/redirects-migrations-testing/): Redirect types, moving a site safely, A/B testing without hurting search, and how to avoid redirect chains.
- [Google Search Operators for SEO](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/search-operators-debug/): Search operators that help debug indexing and spam issues: site:, image operators, security checks and their limits.
- [Preventing Spam and Malware on Your Site](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/security-abuse-prevention/): Protect a website from user-generated spam, malware, unwanted software and phishing, with a site health checklist.
- [SEO for Beginners: SEO Starter Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/seo-starter-guide/): The basics of SEO: help Google find your pages, organise your site, improve content and control how it appears in search.
- [Google Spam Policies Explained](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/spam-policies/): Plain explanations of Google's spam policies: deceptive content, low-quality and scaled content, link schemes and hacked sites.
- [Google Search Technical Requirements](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/technical-requirements/): The three technical requirements for appearing in Google Search: Googlebot access, a working server and indexable content.
- [Debugging Search Traffic Drops](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/traffic-debug-analytics/): Find out why search traffic dropped: common causes, using Search Console with analytics, and reading trends.
- [Meta Tag Analyser Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/meta-tags/): How to use the free Meta Tag Analyser: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Heading Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/headings/): How to use the free Heading Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Image and Alt Text Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/images/): How to use the free Image and Alt Text Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Link Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/links/): How to use the free Link Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Redirect and Status Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/redirects/): How to use the free Redirect and Status Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Robots.txt and Sitemap Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/robots-sitemap/): How to use the free Robots.txt and Sitemap Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [SSL Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/ssl-check/): How to use the free SSL Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Schema and Open Graph Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/schema-social/): How to use the free Schema and Open Graph Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Keyword Density and Readability Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/keyword-density/): How to use the free Keyword Density and Readability Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Website Technology Checker Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/technology/): How to use the free Website Technology Checker: what it checks, how to run it and how to read the result.
- [Free Runs and Limits](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/docs/tools/usage-limits/): How many free tool runs you get each day and month, what does not use a run, and when your free runs reset.

## Articles

- [301 vs 302 Redirects: Which One to Use](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/301-vs-302-redirects/): The difference between permanent and temporary redirects, how Google treats each one, and how to avoid long redirect chains when you move pages.
- [Digital Marketing Strategy for Small Business](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/digital-marketing-strategy-for-small-business/): A simple digital marketing strategy for small businesses and beginners: set goals, know your customer, pick a few channels, publish and measure.
- [Heading Structure Explained: H1 to H6](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/heading-structure-h1-to-h6/): How headings help visitors and assistive technologies, what Google says about the number and order of headings, and a simple outline method.
- [How to Write Title Tags](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/how-to-write-title-tags/): What a title tag does, where Google gets the title link it shows, and a simple method for writing clear, unique page titles.
- [Local SEO for Small Business: A Practical Guide](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/local-seo-for-small-business/): How local SEO works for small businesses: your Google Business Profile, local ranking factors, reviews and the website basics that help you show up nearby.
- [Meta Descriptions: How to Write Them](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/meta-descriptions-guide/): How Google chooses the snippet under a result, when it uses your meta description, and how to write unique descriptions that help people choose.
- [On-Page vs Off-Page SEO: What Each One Covers](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/on-page-vs-off-page-seo/): On-page SEO is what you control on your own pages; off-page SEO is how the rest of the web sees you. What each covers and where to start.
- [robots.txt and XML Sitemaps Explained](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/robots-txt-and-xml-sitemaps/): What robots.txt and XML sitemaps do, the limits Google applies to each, and the common mistake of using robots.txt to hide pages from search.
- [What Are Backlinks? How to Get Them Safely](https://kivoreach.vercel.app/blog/what-are-backlinks/): Backlinks explained: what they are, why they matter for SEO, which links Google treats as spam, and safe ways to get backlinks for a small website.
